MajorSpeech.description: A major speech record as described by the XML dictionary. The dictionary lists title, link and pubDate for an item; the API table additionally lists title, link, date and description. The precise API response envelope and field-name alignment are not fully established.

date.description: Date (D.M.YYYY), as listed in the API field table.

pubDate.description: Date (D.M.YYYY), as listed for an XML item.

info.description: Retrieves Major Speeches of the Chief Secretary for Administration. The version is undocumented and is a metadata placeholder, not a publisher API version. The documentation specifies an English-language search URL and XML field descriptions, but does not describe authentication or the complete response envelope.
info.title: Chief Secretary for Administration — Major Speeches

get.description: Returns major speeches. The documented URL is `https://api.data.gov.hk/v1/cso/majorspeech/search?lang=en&start=<param>&end=<param>`. Start and end must be used together when supplied. If both are omitted, speeches from the last six months are returned. A maximum of 400 records is returned. Dates are interpreted in Hong Kong Time (GMT+8).

parameters.description: Language selector. The documented English URL uses `en`. Other language values are not specified by this dictionary.
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Inclusive start date in YYYYMMDD format, for example `20190102`. The earliest accepted date is 16 January 2017. Must be supplied together with `end`.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Inclusive end date in YYYYMMDD format, for example `20190109`. The latest accepted date is today. Must be supplied together with `start`.
parameters.name: end

items.description: Speech items. The dictionary does not explicitly establish the response-envelope property name; `items` is therefore not asserted as a documented wire key.

200.description: Major speeches search results. The dictionary documents the speech fields but does not specify the complete response envelope or response media type.
